resources.string: Add an account to set up its folders and rules.
Your folders · the AI reads these descriptions
Money at risk, outages, security, deadlines, anyone waiting on me.
Real conversations with people, not automated mail.
Invoices, payments, receipts and bank mail.
Code reviews, tickets, builds, calendars and other work tools.
Automated reports and alerts that are still useful.
Off: its mail stays in Priority
Nothing learned yet. When you move or restore mail, the rule shows up here.
A VIP rule always keeps mail in Priority. Delete it to change where this sender\'s mail goes.
This rule applies to every account.
People you write to are never discarded or junked, whatever a rule says.
What was filed and discarded today, for all accounts
Hold 30 days in Discarded, then Trash
Your server has no Trash folder, so discarded mail is held in Discarded for 30 days instead. The app never creates a Trash folder.
On. Mail is filed and discarded as it arrives.
Label only. Finish the first run to file mail automatically.
Label only for now: your Sent folder changed, so the app is reading its history again to protect the people you write to. Filing resumes when that\'s done.
Label only: no Sent folder was found, so the app can\'t tell who you write to.

Your mail server adds an Authentication-Results line to each message, saying whether the sender passed SPF, DKIM and DMARC. Anyone can forge such a line, so the app only believes the ones from the servers listed here. Add your provider\'s id (for example mx.example.com) only if you know it. Without one, the app trusts the topmost line only.
A JSON file with this account\'s folders, learned rules, VIPs and alert settings. Your password and mail are never in it.
Leave empty for the default description.
Describe in plain words what belongs here. The folder is created on your server the first time mail is filed into it.
Folder names can\'t contain / . % * \\ \" & or control characters.
You already have a folder with that name.
That name is already used by the app or your server.
This replaces this account\'s folders, VIPs, alert levels and discard setting.
The file sets discarded mail to go straight to Trash.
Only tick this if the file is your own: a wrong server id can make forged mail look genuine.
That file is too large to be a rules file
